effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
＜Evade＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may suspend it to prevent that deletion.)
＜Decode (Lv.5 or lower w/[Aqua]/[Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TB] trait)＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 6 or lower card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits or with the [TB] trait from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects or suspend until their turn ends.
